name: Agent profile card
purpose: The single hero prop of the Home 'Control' section — a nested card showing a fictional agent identity, its verified badge, its ID and its human owner.
structuralNote: Two nested bordered cards, not one flat panel — the outer card wraps a second bordered profile panel. There is NO box-shadow and NO small circular avatar beside the name; the photo is a single 160px square thumbnail.
assetPolicy: The agent portrait and the owner avatar are real downloaded brand assets (`portrait.agent`, `portrait.owner` roles) and are must-not-fabricate: a generated page may reference them but must not invent a lookalike of a real person.
